criteria.reason: Concrete inclusive process: mixed walking tour, co-design workshops, listening circles, interviews with both camps; integrates all viewpoints.
Stays neutral; proposes compromises and test phases without advocating for or against the pedestrian zone.
No invented rules, but omits required legal anchor (LAT/RPG art. 4 participation obligation).
Highly actionable: week-by-week plan, concrete formats, clear recommendations.

summary: Solid neutral, concrete participation process integrating all groups, but missing the LAT art. 4 legal anchor.
